linkedin:
Connecting several AI tools to one memory raises a fair question: who gets to see what?

In S3 Brain you decide per tool. Limit a connected tool to read-only access, or to the projects you choose, while another keeps full access to the same memory.

A few more guardrails:
· Credentials written as JSON, YAML or environment-style settings are masked before they're stored
· Remote model endpoints must use HTTPS
· If a connected tool asks for something destructive, S3 Brain waits for your clear yes
· Per project, you can keep to local backends only, stop capturing it, or delete raw conversation text after a number of days

Free for personal use on Mac.
https://s3dat.com/products/s3-brain
